extension_required_body: Your existing spaces and conversations are kept. Install or enable Space Conversations to manage spaces here.
privacy_line: Everything here can be used inside this space. Anything about health, money and other personal matters stays out of lock-screen notifications, and Persona asks before sending it to anyone.
empty_body: Ask something above to start the first one.
gone_body: It may have been removed, or the address is mistyped.
archived_body: It no longer shows in the sidebar. Its conversations and files are kept.
archive_body: The space leaves the sidebar. Its conversations and files stay on the assistant's computer.
categories_body: Everything made in this space is treated as holding these kinds of personal information, so it is used carefully outside the space.
md_intro: Tell the assistant what this space is for and how to help here. It reads this at the start of every conversation in the space.
md_placeholder: For example: who is involved, what to keep track of, how you like answers.
md_managed_block: Kept up to date by Persona
md_unavailable: Can't be read right now. The assistant's computer may be offline or need an update.
md_stale: This was changed somewhere else while you were editing. Load the latest version and make your change again; what you typed here will be replaced.
md_managed: The part Persona keeps up to date can't be changed here. Edit only your own text.
md_missing: This space has no page to edit yet.
md_offline: The assistant's computer is offline or needs an update. Try again later.
new_intro: A space keeps one part of your life together, like health keeps yours: its own conversations, its own notes, and its own memory.
field_categories_hint: Optional. Anything made here is then always handled with care outside the space.
field_slug_hint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes, starting with a letter.
field_slug_taken: Another space already uses this address.
health_read_only: Health is switched off. Existing conversations, reports, and memory stay available here, read-only.
empty_readonly_body: There are no saved conversations yet.
report_no_record: This report has no summary yet. Open the original to see the report itself.
